title: 第10章 和君仗剑切磋，就这？就这？
content_zh:
之前君仗剑曾隐隐听他这一脉的族老说过，君逍遥乃是荒古圣体。
那时君仗剑还有几分不信。
不说荒古圣体在近古几乎绝迹，即便偶尔能够出现一位，也很快泯然众人矣。
因为近古以来，天地环境不适合荒古圣体修炼，甚至天降十道枷锁，禁锢圣体修炼。
如果君逍遥真的是荒古圣体，那等于就是鸡肋废体。
试问十八祖会重视一位废体吗？
因此，君仗剑一直认为，君逍遥可能是某种类似荒古圣体的体质。
但是现在，他看到君逍遥抬手间，金色法力澎湃，的确像是荒古圣体。
因为荒古圣体，天生金色灵海，连血液都是金灿灿的圣血。
“莫非逍遥族弟，真的是传闻中的荒古圣体？”君仗剑不由问道。
“没错。”君逍遥淡淡点头。
这本身就不是什么秘密，他也不准备隐藏。
听到君逍遥亲口确认，君仗剑眸光一震，而那跪在地上的兰清雅，也是心头震动。
“竟然真的是荒古圣体，既然这样，君仗剑为何还要忌惮一个鸡肋废体……”兰清雅低着头，眼底深藏着怨毒之色。
今日之辱，她难以忘记。
“既然如此，那我就先告辞了。”君仗剑微微拱手。
被割了一大块肉，君仗剑已经不想在这待下去了。
“慢着……”君逍遥忽然说道。
“逍遥族弟，你……”君仗剑嘴角隐隐抽搐。
难道这位族弟，贪心不足蛇吞象？

“咳……仗剑族兄，你误会了，我只是见猎心喜，想要和你切磋一番。”君逍遥干咳一声道。
君仗剑眼露异色，摇头微微笑道：“逍遥族弟，你年岁尚幼，没有必要如此，等你日后长大了，我们再来切磋。”
君逍遥只有三岁，而君仗剑已经十三四岁了。
若是到时候打伤了君逍遥，他根本承担不起十八祖的怒火。
因此君仗剑直接拒绝。
“只是切磋而已，希望族兄莫要拒绝。”君逍遥坚持道。
“哎，既然如此，那好吧，不过希望族弟量力而行。”君仗剑一脸从容淡然之色。
比身份地位，他的确比不过君逍遥。
但论修为境界，他足可碾压君逍遥。
片刻后，他们来到了天帝宫外的一处空地。
这时，在天帝宫外，早就汇聚了一批看热闹的君家人，探头探脑，想要得知事情的结果。
他们看到君逍遥和君仗剑走出，像是要开打的模样，脸上一片惊愕。
“这是怎么回事，不是说来赔礼道歉吗，怎么还打起来了？”
“不对，看逍遥神子模样，他们应该没有发生冲突，只是切磋而已。”一些明眼人看出来了。
他们眼中都是露出感兴趣的神色。
这两人的切磋，很有看头。
一位是自小光环无数的神子，一位是早已成名的第十序列。
虽然碍于年龄和修为，没有人认为君逍遥能够胜过君仗剑，不过他们依然在赌。
“你们说，逍遥神子能够在君仗剑手中撑几招？”
“我猜三招。”

“不对，最少也可以撑十招吧。”
听到那些人的话语，君仗剑嘴角不自觉勾起。
虽说交出一块元天至尊令，令他心在滴血，但是现在，貌似能够出一出风头。
“逍遥族弟，小心了！”
君仗剑说罢，神宫五重天的气息狂涌而出。
他没有用任何武学招式，直接并指为剑，对着君逍遥点出。
君逍遥见状，也是简简单单，五指握拳轰击而出。
体内一千颗巨象微粒觉醒，加持了一千万斤恐怖神力。
这一拳轰出，虚空都好似扭曲了，一团巨大的空气炮轰然暴涌而出！
感受到这股威能，君仗剑脸色当即变了，急忙想要抽回手，但依然避之不及。
一声巨响传出，伴随着骨裂的咔嚓声，君仗剑身形如同炮弹一般被砸飞，手指骨都是碎裂。
这一幕，令所有看热闹的君家人愕然。
究竟发什么了什么？
那跟随而出的兰清雅，脸色也是凝固。
君玲珑美眸异彩连连，她果然没有跟错人。
“咳咳……”君仗剑灰头土脸，手指骨碎裂，眼底也是深藏着骇然。
那股恐怖神力，令他都是心有余悸。
而君逍遥本人，也是非常意外。
君仗剑不是君家第十序列吗，不是应该很厉害吗？
就这？就这？

君逍遥脸色微沉道：“仗剑族兄，你不能因为我年纪小，就如此谦让我，这是对我的侮辱。”
说罢，君逍遥直接主动出手。
君仗剑脸色变化，同时心头苦啊。
他对天发誓，绝对没有谦让。
然而不仅是君逍遥，就连那些君家的吃瓜群众，也在议论纷纷，都认为是君仗剑谦让了。
“旭日九剑！”
看着再度袭来的君逍遥，君仗剑也是不得不全力出手了。
他九道剑光接连斩出，撕裂空气，波动强绝，令人心惊。
“冥神守护！”
君逍遥直接催动神象镇狱劲中的防御绝学。
霎时，仿佛有一道冥神虚影显化而出，将他整个身体都笼罩在内。
九道剑光撞击在冥神虚影上，直接是崩碎为无数光点。
君逍遥再度冲出，背后显化出一对漆黑的羽翼，正是恶魔之翼。
他的速度顿时暴涨，直接闪身到君仗剑身前。
“冥神之矛！”
君逍遥抬手一抓，无尽神能澎湃，化为一杆紫黑色的长矛，燃烧着漆黑冥炎，仿佛可以洞穿世间万物。
“紫皇剑诀！”
君仗剑匆忙之下，施展自己的底牌剑诀，一道紫色剑影横空斩出。
大碰撞爆发，然而结局是，加持了一千万斤巨力的冥神之矛，直接破开了紫色剑影，然后去势不减的落向君仗剑。
君仗剑急忙祭出背后长剑，横剑而挡。

一击巨响碰撞，君仗剑手中长剑都是被击飞，整个人被抛飞，轰然砸在了一侧墙壁之中。
那些来看热闹的君家人，眼珠子都快瞪出来了，眼中写满震撼。
这才不过三招来回吧？
第十序列君仗剑竟然就被打趴下了？
即便是谦让，也不可能谦让到这种程度啊。
这下，就连君逍遥都反应了过来。
原来君仗剑并没有谦让，是他太强了啊。
一想到误会了君仗剑，君逍遥暗暗摇头，非常自责。
他走到灰头土脸的君仗剑身前，满怀歉疚道：“抱歉，仗剑族兄，误会了你，还以为你是谦让，没想到你是真的尽力了啊……”
君仗剑听到这话，刚咽下去的血差点又要吐出来。
他心里有句妈卖批不知当讲不当讲！
content_en:
Jun Zhanjian had vaguely heard the elders of his lineage say before that Jun Xiaoyao was an ancient holy body.
At that time, Jun Zhanjian still didn't believe it.
Not to mention that the ancient holy body was almost extinct in recent times. Even if one occasionally appeared, it would soon be lost to everyone.
Because in recent times, the environment of heaven and earth has not been suitable for the practice of the Ancient Holy Body, and even ten shackles have been sent down from the sky to imprison the practice of the Holy Body.
If Jun Xiaoyao is really the ancient holy body, it is tantamount to a useless body.
Would the Eighteenth Patriarch value a waste body?
Therefore, Jun Zhanjian has always believed that Jun Xiaoyao may have a physique similar to the ancient holy body.
But now, he saw Jun Xiaoyao raising his hand, golden mana surging, indeed like an ancient holy body.
Because the ancient holy body was born with a golden spiritual sea, even its blood was golden holy blood.
"Could it be that the Xiaoyao clan brother is really the rumored ancient holy body?" Jun Zhanjian couldn't help but ask.
"That's right." Jun Xiaoyao nodded lightly.
This in itself was not a secret, and he was not prepared to hide it.
Hearing Jun Xiaoyao's personal confirmation, Jun Zhanjian's eyes trembled, and Lan Qingya, who was kneeling on the ground, was also shocked.
"It turns out to be the ancient holy body. In this case, why should Jun Zhanjian be afraid of a worthless body..." Lan Qingya lowered her head, with a look of resentment deep in her eyes.
She would never forget today's humiliation.
"In that case, I'll take my leave first." Jun Zhanjian slightly arched his hand.
After being cut off a large piece of flesh, Jun Zhanjian no longer wanted to stay here.
"Wait a minute..." Jun Xiaoyao said suddenly.
"Brother Xiaoyao Clan, you..." The corner of Jun Zhanjian's mouth twitched faintly.
Could it be that this clan brother is too greedy to swallow an elephant?
"Ahem... Brother Zhanjian Clan, you misunderstood. I am just happy to see Hunter Xin and want to have a discussion with you." Jun Xiaoyao coughed dryly.
Jun Zhanjian's eyes showed a strange color, he shook his head and smiled slightly: "Brother Xiaoyao Clan, you are still young, there is no need to be like this. When you grow up in the future, we will learn from each other again."
Jun Xiaoyao is only three years old, while Jun Zhanjian is already thirteen or fourteen years old.
If Jun Xiaoyao was injured by then, he would not be able to bear the wrath of the Eighteenth Ancestor.
Therefore, Jun Zhanjian refused directly.
"It's just a discussion. I hope my brother won't refuse." Jun Xiaoyao insisted.
"Hey, if that's the case, then fine, but I hope the clan brother will act within his ability." Jun Zhanjian looked calm and indifferent.
In terms of status, he is indeed not as good as Jun Xiaoyao.
But in terms of cultivation level, he can crush Jun Xiaoyao.
After a while, they came to an open space outside the Emperor's Palace.
At this time, outside the Heavenly Emperor's Palace, a group of Jun family members had gathered to watch the excitement, poking around to learn the outcome of the matter.
They saw Jun Xiaoyao and Jun Zhanjian walking out, as if they were about to start a fight, and their faces were filled with shock.
"What's going on? Didn't you say you were here to apologize? Why are you still fighting?"
"No, judging from the appearance of Xiaoyao Shenzi, they probably didn't have any conflict, they were just comparing notes." Some discerning people could tell.
There was interest in their eyes.
The discussion between these two people is very interesting.
One is the son of God who has had countless auras since childhood, and the other is the tenth sequence who has already become famous.
Although no one thought Jun Xiaoyao could beat Jun Zhanjian due to age and cultivation, they were still betting.
"How many moves do you think the Son of God Xiaoyao can withstand in Jun Zhanjian's hands?"
"I guess three moves."
"No, it can last at least ten moves."
After hearing those people's words, Jun Zhanjian's lips curled up unconsciously.
Although handing over a piece of Yuantian Supreme Token made his heart bleed, now, it seems that he can make a splash.
"Brother Xiaoyao, be careful!"
After Jun Zhanjian said that, the aura from the fifth level of the palace surged out.
He didn't use any martial arts moves, he directly pointed his sword at Jun Xiaoyao.
When Jun Xiaoyao saw this, he simply made a fist with five fingers and struck out.
One thousand in the bodyThe giant elephant particle awakens and is blessed with ten million kilograms of terrifying divine power.
With this punch, the void seemed to be distorted, and a huge air cannon burst out!
Feeling this power, Jun Zhanjian's expression immediately changed, and he hurriedly tried to withdraw his hand, but still couldn't avoid it.
There was a loud noise, accompanied by the cracking sound of bone cracking. Jun Zhanjian's figure was smashed away like a cannonball, and his finger bones were shattered.
This scene shocked all the Jun family members who were watching the excitement.
What exactly was posted?
Lan Qingya, who followed, also had a frozen face.
Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes were shining again and again, she was indeed with the wrong person.
"Ahem..." Jun Zhanjian looked disgraced, his finger bones were shattered, and there was deep horror in his eyes.
That terrifying divine power left him with lingering fears.
Jun Xiaoyao himself was also very surprised.
Isn't Jun Zhanjian the tenth rank of the Jun family? Shouldn't he be very powerful?
That's it? That's it?
Jun Xiaoyao's face darkened and he said, "Brother from the Zhanjian Clan, you can't be so humble to me just because I'm young. This is an insult to me."
Having said that, Jun Xiaoyao took the initiative directly.
Jun Zhanjian's expression changed, and at the same time he felt bitter.
He swore to God that he would never give in.
However, not only Jun Xiaoyao, but also the melon-eating people of the Jun family were also talking about it, thinking that Jun Zhanjian had given in.
"Nine Swords of the Rising Sun!"
Seeing Jun Xiaoyao attacking again, Jun Zhanjian had no choice but to take action with all his strength.
He slashed out nine rays of sword light one after another, tearing the air, and the waves were powerful and frightening.
"Guardian of Hades!"
Jun Xiaoyao directly activated the defensive skills in the divine elephant's prison-suppressing power.
In an instant, it seemed as if a shadow of Hades appeared and enveloped his entire body.
The nine sword lights hit the shadow of Hades and shattered into countless light spots.
Jun Xiaoyao rushed out again, and a pair of dark wings appeared from his back, which were the wings of the devil.
His speed suddenly increased and he dodged directly in front of Jun Zhanjian.
"Spear of Hades!"
Jun Xiaoyao raised his hand to grab it, and the endless divine energy surged, turning into a purple-black spear, burning with dark flames, as if it could penetrate everything in the world.
"Purple Emperor Sword Technique!"
In a hurry, Jun Zhanjian used his trump card sword technique, and a purple sword shadow slashed out across the sky.
A big collision broke out, but the ending was that the Spear of Hades, which was blessed with a huge force of 10 million kilograms, directly broke through the purple sword shadow, and then fell towards Jun Zhanjian unabated.
Jun Zhanjian hurriedly drew out his long sword from behind and blocked it with his sword horizontally.
With a loud collision, the long sword in Jun Zhanjian's hand was knocked away, and his whole body was thrown away, slamming into a wall on one side.
The eyes of the Jun family members who came to see the fun almost popped out of their heads, and their eyes were full of shock.
This is only three moves back and forth, right?
In the tenth sequence, Jun Zhanjian was beaten to the ground?
Even if you are humble, you cannot be humble to this extent.
At this time, even Jun Xiaoyao reacted.
It turns out that Jun Zhanjian was not humble, because he was too strong.
When he thought of misunderstanding Jun Zhanjian, Jun Xiaoyao shook his head secretly, blaming himself very much.
He walked up to the disgraced Jun Zhanjian and said apologetically: "I'm sorry, Brother Zhanjian, I misunderstood you and thought you were being modest. I didn't expect you really tried your best..."
When Jun Zhanjian heard this, he almost vomited out the blood he had just swallowed.
He has a saying in his heart: "Mom sells batches" and he doesn't know whether to say it or not!
